name: Red Hat Title Slide
description: Opening/title slide from the Red Hat corporate template. Has branded background (inherited), Red Hat logo image, title, subtitle, presenter name, and date fields.
usage_notes: Copy this slide manually from the template into position 1 of the target deck to preserve branding/background.
Then update text fields via the API using deleteText + insertText.
Delete any 'Quick tip' helper text boxes that come from the template.

title.placeholder_text: Presentation title should not exceed two lines

workflow.step1: Copy slide from template (1nv_haj_O-miYUbNcFt3JgRF7e9FodNvRXjxjmpd7LLM) slide 9 into position 1 of target deck.
workflow.step2: Find text elements by their y-position: title (~1.43in), subtitle (~2.89in), presenter (~3.78in left), date (~3.78in right).
workflow.step3: Use deleteText + insertText to replace placeholder text.
